email.subject: AI for Connors & Connors, P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi John,

Since 1955, Connors & Connors has built a reputation defending liability claims across New York and New Jersey with skill and focus. That kind of regional presence and client trust is exactly what we see in the firms choosing Lucio over larger platforms.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping practices like yours compete with bigger operations.

Worth 20 minutes to explore?

Vasu
Lucio
